headline: Central coastal district with high amenity density and premium property prices

tags.reason: Secondary flats average an estimated 4,132 AZN per square metre compared to the Baku median of 2,084 AZN.
The district records 40.25 food venues and 10.28 bank outlets per 10,000 residents against city medians of 11.37 and 2.96.
There are 2.06 universities per 10,000 residents, exceeding the Baku median of 0.9.

summary: Səbail records an affordability index of 4 against the Baku median of 50, reflecting high estimated secondary flat prices of 4,132 AZN per square metre. Daily convenience is supported by 40.25 food venues and 18.41 parks per 10,000 residents compared to city medians of 11.37 and 10.04. However, early education shows 1.47 kindergartens per 10,000 residents, trailing the Baku median of 2.32. Across 4,297 active property listings, 84% possess a title extract (çıxarış) and 30% are eligible for a mortgage.
strengths: High concentration of dining establishments throughout the district (40.25 food venues per 10,000 residents; Baku median 11.37)
Substantial green space and recreational park access (18.41 parks per 10,000 residents; Baku median 10.04)
Strong commercial and financial service availability (10.28 bank ATMs and branches per 10,000 residents; Baku median 2.96)
weaknesses: Severely constrained purchasing affordability across housing types (affordability index 4; Baku median 50)
Lower proportion of paved surfaces on recorded roads (72.9% paved of known roads; Baku median 83.1%)
Below-average provision of pre-school education facilities (1.47 kindergartens per 10,000 residents; Baku median 2.32)
best_for: Buyers prioritising dense leisure, park access, and financial infrastructure
University students and academics needing proximity to higher education centres
Purchasers requiring documented properties, with an 84% title extract (çıxarış) rate
watch_out: Secondary housing costs average an estimated 4,132 AZN per square metre versus the city median of 2,084 AZN
Road surface information remains unrecorded for 77.4% of the local network
The recorded land price of 60,000 AZN per sot is a mock demo figure
confidence_note: OpenStreetMap data coverage is high, but the secondary flat price of 4,132 AZN per square metre is an estimate and the land price of 60,000 AZN per sot is a mock value.
